lines.cap: Go just one day without it, and your body starts begging.
lines.say: Go just one day without it, and your body starts begging.

lines.cap: Water. About sixty percent of you is water, and you lose around two and a half litres a day.
lines.say: Water. About sixty percent of you is water, and you lose around two and a half litres a day.

lines.cap: Lose just one or two percent, and you feel thirsty. Your mouth goes dry.
lines.say: Lose just one or two percent, and you feel thirsty. Your mouth goes dry.

lines.cap: At two percent, studies show focus, mood and memory start to slip. Headaches begin.
lines.say: At two percent, studies show focus, mood and memory start to slip. Headaches begin.

lines.cap: Your kidneys try to save every drop. Your pee turns dark.
lines.say: Your kidneys try to save every drop. Your pee turns dark.

lines.cap: Your blood gets thicker, your heart beats faster, and you feel dizzy when you stand up.
lines.say: Your blood gets thicker, your heart beats faster, and you feel dizzy when you stand up.

lines.cap: Most people can only survive a few days without water. Heat and exercise make it faster.
lines.say: Most people can only survive a few days without water. Heat and exercise make it faster.

lines.cap: So drink up. Your body is asking nicely. General information, not medical advice.
lines.say: So drink up. Your body is asking nicely. General information, not medical advice.
